hook.en: From Naning in 1831 to Terengganu in 1928, local fighters across our country risked everything to defend their land, faith and way of life.
hook.bm: Dari Naning pada 1831 hingga Terengganu pada 1928, pejuang tempatan di seluruh negara mempertaruhkan segala-galanya untuk mempertahankan tanah, agama dan cara hidup mereka.

bigIdeas.en: The aim of resistance was to defend sovereignty, religion, customs and traditional rights.
bigIdeas.bm: Matlamat penentangan ialah mempertahankan kedaulatan, agama, adat dan hak tradisional.

bigIdeas.en: Western rule took away chiefs' powers, introduced new taxes and land laws, and ignored local customs.
bigIdeas.bm: Pemerintahan Barat menghapuskan kuasa pembesar, memperkenalkan cukai dan undang-undang tanah baharu, serta mengabaikan adat tempatan.

bigIdeas.en: Resistance was put down, but it inspired the later spirit of nationalism.
bigIdeas.bm: Penentangan dipatahkan, tetapi ia menjadi inspirasi semangat nasionalisme kemudiannya.

definition.en: The right of a ruler or people to govern themselves.
definition.bm: Hak pemerintah atau rakyat untuk memerintah diri sendiri.

definition.en: Fighting with weapons against the colonial power.
Refusing orders, petitions, protests and writing.
definition.bm: Enggan mematuhi arahan, petisyen, bantahan dan penulisan.

definition.en: Being sent away from one's homeland as punishment.
definition.bm: Dihantar jauh dari tanah air sebagai hukuman.

definition.en: Love of the nation and the desire to be free from foreign rule.
definition.bm: Semangat cinta akan negara dan keinginan bebas daripada pemerintahan asing.

question.en: Why did Dato' Maharaja Lela oppose J.W.W. Birch?
question.bm: Mengapakah Dato' Maharaja Lela menentang J.W.W. Birch?

steps.en: Birch took over tax collection from Malay chiefs.
steps.bm: Birch mengambil alih pemungutan cukai daripada pembesar Melayu.

steps.en: He ignored Malay customs and the dignity of the rulers.
steps.bm: Beliau mengabaikan adat Melayu dan maruah raja.

answer.en: To defend Malay rights, customs and sovereignty — Birch was killed at Pasir Salak in 1875.
answer.bm: Untuk mempertahankan hak, adat dan kedaulatan Melayu — Birch dibunuh di Pasir Salak pada 1875.
